jobs.title: Program Manager, Card Plastics
jobs.description:
Calling all innovators - find your future at Fiserv.

We're Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants and consumers to one another millions of times a day - quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we're involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.

Job Title
Program Manager, Card Plastics

What does a successful Program Manager, Card Plastics do at Fiserv?

As a successful Program Manager, Card Plastics, you will play a pivotal role in shaping and executing go-to-market strategies that elevate our card plastics product visibility, drive client engagement, grow pipeline, and support revenue growth. You will assist with GTM strategy design, enable cross-functional execution, compelling value propositions, identify and target whitespace, and ensure that sales initiatives are scalable, data-driven, and tightly aligned with Issuer Solutions growth objectives.

What you will do:
- Drive the development and refinement of integrated card plastics strategies for new product launches, market expansion and customer segmentation.
- Partner with Marketing, Product, Customer Success, and Finance to ensure plastics  strategies align with customer needs and market dynamics.
- Promote go-to-market planning and sales execution for new product launches, ensuring alignment with product strategy and commercialization timelines.
- Collaborate with sales leaders to understand their needs and develop tailored strategies that drive growth and improve sales
-  Analyze customer segments and market data to determine where opportunities exist, Facilitating the execution, ongoing project management and reporting of new strategies.  Analyzing sales performance data to identify trends, gaps, and opportunities for improvement. Provide actionable insights to sales leaders.
- Create and maintain sales enablement materials, including pitch decks, product sheets, and client-facing collateral.

What you will need to have:
- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Marketing, or related field;
- 4+ years of experience in card plastics, GTM execution or sales/revenue operations roles.
- Proven ability to drive GTM strategy development and execute cross-functional initiatives that drive revenue.
- Strong analytical skills and experience using CRM, sales analytics, and forecasting tools (e.g., Salesforce, Clari, Tableau).
- Excellent executive communication and stakeholder management skills.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (especially PowerPoint) and familiarity with marketing tools such as Salesforce, Eloqua, or Seismic.

What would be great to have:
- Strategic and structured thinker with strong problem-solving skills.
- Experience in product marketing or commercialization within a large enterprise.
- Familiarity with Issuer Solutions, Output Solutions, or Money Network products.
- Comfortable in fast-paced, high-growth environments.
- Highly organized with exceptional project management skills..
- Demonstrated success in supporting plastics sales enablement and client-facing initiatives.

You must currently possess valid and unrestricted U.S. work authorization to be considered for this role. Individuals with temporary visas including, but not limited to, F-1 (OPT, CPT, STEM), H-1B, H-2, or TN, or any candidate requiring sponsorship, now or in the future, will not be considered for this role.

$71,400.00 - $151,900.00

These pay ranges apply to employees in New Jersey and New York. Pay ranges for employees in other states may differ.

It is unlawful to discriminate against a prospective employee due to the individual's status as a veteran.

Job Title
Program Manager

Program Manager
About your role:
As a Program Manager, you will lead complex, cross-functional technical programs that span engineering, product, infrastructure, and business teams. You will partner with Principal Engineers, architects, and senior stakeholders to drive execution across large-scale initiatives while translating technical complexity into clear delivery plans and business outcomes. Your work will help improve execution discipline, reduce delivery risk, and align architecture, engineering, and operational priorities across the enterprise.
What you'll do:
- Lead large-scale technical programs across multiple engineering, product, and business organizations, ensuring alignment to strategic objectives, scope, timelines, and measurable outcomes.
- Partner with Principal Engineers and technical leaders to participate in architecture and system design discussions, evaluate trade-offs, and challenge assumptions that affect delivery, scale, and resilience.
- Map and manage complex dependencies, critical paths, and execution risks across software engineering, infrastructure, cloud, data platform, and application programming interface (API) workstreams.
- Define and drive program governance, including milestone tracking, risk management, issue resolution, change control, and executive reporting across cross-functional teams.
- Establish and monitor program-level key performance indicators (KPIs), service-level agreement (SLA) metrics, delivery dashboards, and operational measures that improve execution transparency and accountability.
- Apply Agile, Scrum, Kanban, or hybrid delivery frameworks to optimize planning, sprint health, throughput, and delivery predictability across technical teams.
- Identify technical risks early in the lifecycle, including structural bottlenecks, single points of failure, scalability concerns, or security risks, and drive mitigation planning with stakeholders.
- Translate technical blockers, architecture decisions, and delivery impacts into clear business context for senior leaders and non-technical stakeholders.
- Drive alignment across engineering, product, and executive stakeholders without direct authority, building consensus around technical strategy and execution priorities.
- Structure ambiguous or evolving business goals into executable technical roadmaps, sequencing plans, and cross-team workstreams.
- Responsibilities listed are not intended to be all-inclusive and may be modified as necessary.

Experience you'll need to have:
- 8+ years of experience in software engineering, systems engineering, technical architecture, or related technical disciplines supporting complex technology environments.
- 3+ years of experience leading cross-functional technical programs involving multiple engineering, product, and business stakeholders.
- Experience engaging in technical architecture discussions across software engineering, cloud platforms such as Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Microsoft Azure, infrastructure, data platforms, and APIs.
- Experience with software development lifecycle (SDLC) processes, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), release management, and testing frameworks in enterprise delivery environments.
- Experience identifying and managing technical risks, dependencies, scaling considerations, and execution blockers across large programs.
- Experience building delivery dashboards, KPIs, milestone tracking, SLA reporting, or similar operational governance measures for technical programs.
- Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or related field or equivalent combination of education, related experience and/or military experience.

Experience that would be great to have:
- Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field.
- Experience in financial services, payments, or other regulated technology environments.
- Experience managing external technical partners, vendors, or third-party delivery dependencies.
- Agile, Scrum, SAFe, Project Management Professional (PMP), or equivalent certification.

How you'll work:
- This role is on-site Monday through Friday. Fiserv considers in-person collaboration to be an essential part of this role as in-person office experiences help you with your overall onboarding experience and leads to stronger productivity .

jobs.description:

We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.

Job Title
Senior Programme Manager

About your role:
This role suits a seasoned delivery leader (15–20+ years' experience) who can own the client relationship at executive level, shape programme direction where clarity is lacking, and drive teams toward outcomes in complex multi-stakeholder environments. The ideal candidate will combine deep payments domain expertise with a forward-thinking approach to AI-enabled delivery — leveraging automation, agentic AI, and data-driven decision-making to transform programme execution.

What you’ll do:
Strategic Client Leadership
- Own and develop the client relationship at executive level — acting as a trusted strategic partner, not just a delivery manager.
- Lead governance forums, steering committees, and executive reviews with authority and credibility.
- Anticipate client needs, proactively shape engagement strategy, and identify opportunities to deepen the relationship and expand scope.
- Navigate complex client politics and competing priorities, building consensus and driving alignment at senior levels.
- Use AI-supported insights to strengthen client communications, forecasting, and strategic decision-making.
- Manage escalations with composure and judgement, maintaining trust even under pressure.

Programme Delivery & Governance
- Lead multiple concurrent BAU, change, and transformation programmes with varied scope and complexity — taking full accountability for outcomes.
- Own the full delivery lifecycle from initiation through closure, with particular expertise in large-scale card issuing data migration programmes.
- Drive migration strategy, rehearsals, cutovers, and rollback planning with rigour and attention to operational risk.
- Operate confidently in ambiguous environments — structuring unclear programmes, making decisions with incomplete information, and adapting approach as understanding evolves.
- Drive adoption of AI-enabled delivery approaches including automated status reporting, predictive risk and dependency analysis, and data-driven capacity planning.
- Ensure all deliveries meet Fiserv quality standards, contractual commitments, and regulatory obligations.

Team Leadership & Capability Building
- Build, lead, and motivate cross-functional delivery teams — setting clear expectations and fostering a culture of ownership and accountability.
- Mentor and develop project managers and delivery leads within the team.
- Champion consistent use of automation and AI tooling across delivery teams to reduce manual effort and improve quality.
- Lead by example in adopting modern delivery practices and continuous improvement.

Cross-Functional Coordination
- Orchestrate delivery across global, onshore, and offshore teams — ensuring alignment and removing blockers at pace.
- Coordinate effectively across Product, Technology, Architecture, Operations, Compliance, and Integration functions.
- Work with payment schemes (Visa, Mastercard), third-party vendors, and regulators where required.
- Drive cross-programme dependency management and resource optimisation across the portfolio.

Risk, Issue & Change Management
- Proactively identify and manage delivery, regulatory, operational, and migration-specific risks — with strong judgement on escalation vs resolution.
- Apply AI-assisted risk identification and trend analysis to stay ahead of emerging issues.
- Manage scope changes, CRs, and client expectations through robust governance and clear communication.
- Ensure compliance with Fiserv standards and regional regulatory frameworks (CBUAE, SAMA, etc.).

Financial & Commercial Accountability
- Own programme P&L — tracking budgets, resource utilisation, margin, and commercial exposure.
- Use automation and AI-driven analysis to improve forecasting accuracy and cost transparency.
- Lead SOW development, effort estimation, and contract negotiations.
- Partner with sales and commercial teams to identify growth opportunities within existing accounts.
- Manage commercial risk and ensure programmes remain within agreed financial parameters.

Experience you’ll need to have:
- 15–20+ years of experience in programme or project management within payments, card processing, or financial services technology.
- Deep expertise in payments processing, particularly credit card issuing and platform migrations.
- Proven leadership of large-scale, multi-stream data migration programmes in the card issuing domain, including card portfolios, customer/account data, transaction and balance migration, cutover planning, parallel runs, and post-migration stabilisation.
- Extensive experience managing enterprise clients at C-suite and VP level, with a consultative, trusted-adviser approach.
- Strong delivery track record in credit card issuing and large-scale data migration programmes — multiple successful migrations delivered.
- Practical experience using AI and automation to streamline delivery, governance, and reporting — beyond assistive tooling into embedded and agentic AI.
- Strong understanding of card issuing platforms (VisionPLUS / FirstVision), data flows, and migration risks.
- PMP, PRINCE2 Practitioner, MSP, or equivalent programme management certification.

Experience that would be great to have:
- Experience across multiple card processing platforms (FirstVision, CMS, TSYS, Cortex).
- Knowledge of ISO 8583 messaging, card scheme certification, and service-based integrations.
- Prior experience in management consultancy or professional services delivery.
- Experience managing programmes with budgets exceeding $5M.
- Familiarity with portfolio management and PMO leadership.

Salary starting at € 77,670 - negotiable depending on experience

Job Title
Director, Strategy and Operations

About your role:
As Director, Strategy and Operations, you will be the strategic and operating partner to the VP, Call Center Operations, and an extension of the VP across a global service operations organization. You will turn priorities into plans, plans into decisions, and decisions into execution. You will own the analytics, executive presentations, leadership narratives, and operating rhythm that keep the leadership team aligned and moving. This is a hands-on role for a builder who does the work, not one who delegates it.

What you'll do:
- Run the leadership team's operating rhythm, including staff meetings, business reviews, offsites, and action and decision tracking

- Build executive presentations, leadership narratives, and strategy updates for VP, COO, and CEO audiences that frame trade-offs and drive decisions

- Draft and manage communications on behalf of the VP to leaders, frontline teams, partners, and executives

- Own the transformation portfolio and PMO across active workstreams, including business process outsourcing (BPO), knowledge and artificial intelligence (AI), quality, workforce strategy, and service model evolution

- Personally build the analytics: key performance indicator (KPI) frameworks, dashboards, business cases, and root cause analyses that turn data into actionable recommendations

- Deliver rapid-turn analysis and decision support on the VP's top priorities, often on short timelines

- Lead cross-functional working sessions with partners across Operations, Product, Technology, Quality Assurance (QA), Training, and Commercialization to align priorities, resolve blockers, and drive accountability

- Coach analysts, including talent from analyst programs, and set the quality bar for portfolio deliverables

- 5 years of experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, chief of staff, strategy and operations, or transformation roles supporting complex, cross-functional business initiatives.

- 5 years of experience building executive presentations, strategic narratives, business cases, and decision-support materials for senior leadership audiences using PowerPoint and data-driven storytelling.

- 5 years of hands-on experience analyzing operational performance through KPI frameworks, dashboard development, and root cause analysis using Excel, reporting tools, and related analytics methods.

- Strong executive writing skills, with the ability to produce clear, concise communications for senior leaders and broad audiences.

- Demonstrated experience influencing senior cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority and handling confidential matters with discretion.

- Bachelor's degree or higher in business, finance, operations, analytics, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education, related experience and/or military experience.

- Experience moving from consulting delivery into an embedded operating role with ongoing ownership of outcomes

- Experience in financial services, fintech, or payments environments with regulatory, operational, and cross-functional complexity.

- Experience coaching or leading analysts across multiple concurrent workstreams.

Job Title
Senior Finance Manager (m/w/d)

Über Vert
Vert – Powered by Deutsche Bank – bietet moderne All-in-one-Lösungen für den stationären Handel. Von bargeldloser Zahlungsabwicklung über hochwertige Payment-Hardware bis hin zu innovativer Kassen- und Business-Software erhalten unsere Kundinnen und Kunden alles aus einer Hand. Ergänzt wird das Angebot durch umfassende Finanzdienstleistungen.
Als Partner von Fiserv und der Deutschen Bank verbinden wir langjährige Payment-Expertise mit der Dynamik eines modernen Vertriebsunternehmens. Unsere Mission: Zahlungen einfach, sicher und effizient zu machen, damit sich unsere Kundinnen und Kunden auf ihr Kerngeschäft konzentrieren können.

Überblick
Gesucht wird eine dynamische und unternehmerisch denkende Finance-Persönlichkeit. Die Rolle vereint Controlling, Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) sowie weitere Finance Themen. Sie sind eng eingebunden oder leiten strategische Zukunftsprojekte teamübergreifend (u.a. mit Product Management, Marketing, Risk, Operations).

Sie arbeiten sowohl eng mit der Geschäftsführung des Joint Ventures als auch mit einer internationalen Matrixorganisation deren verschiedenen Finance-Teams. Zu Ihren Aufgaben zählen unter anderem Analysen, Budget- und Forecast-Planung, Reporting sowie die das Controlling der Profitabilität des Bestandsgeschäftes sowie der Vertriebseffektivität. Sie sind außerdem verantwortlich für die Berechnung von Vertriebsprovisionen.

Ihre Aufgaben
- Aktive Unterstützung des CFOs bei finanziellen und betriebswirtschaftlichen Fragestellungen
- Erstellung von Monatsabschlüssen sowie Analyse von Planungen, Forecasts und Geschäftsergebnissen für das Management und den Konzern
- Mitwirkung bei der Erstellung von Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresbudgets
- Unterstützung der Fachbereiche Vertrieb, IT, Produktmanagement und Legal bei finanziellen Analysen sowie Controlling-Themen
- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Konzernansprechpartnern im Bereich Provisionsabrechnung
- Erstellung und Pflege von Provisionsmodellen und Berechnungsvorlagen für verschiedene Business Units
- Aufbereitung und Analyse von Umsatz- und Vertriebsdaten als Grundlage für die monatliche und quartalsweise Provisionsabrechnung
- Durchführung von Provisionsberechnungen einschließlich Bearbeitung von Sonderfällen, Korrekturen und Anpassungen
- Einholung erforderlicher Freigaben für Provisionszahlungen in Zusammenarbeit mit den Fachbereichen, dem Management und HR
- Erstellung von Provisionsabrechnungen sowie Bereitstellung relevanter Informationen für die Gehaltsabrechnung
- Erstellung und Versand von Provisionsübersichten an die jeweiligen Business Units
- Pflege und Auswertung von Headcount-Daten sowie Erstellung regelmäßiger Personalkosten- und Headcount-Reports
- Erstellung und Analyse von CRM-Reports zur Identifikation abgeschlossener Vertriebsaktivitäten

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.

We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.

Job Title
Program Manager

What Does a successful Program Manager do at Fiserv?
As a successful Program Manager, you will ensure Fiserv consistently delivers on its commitments to strategic financial institution clients. You will play a pivotal role in driving client satisfaction, delivery excellence and long-term partnership value by orchestrating complex programs and portfolios across the organization.

What you will do:
· Serve as the primary program owner for medium to high-complexity programs, portfolios or projects of strategic importance.
· Build and maintain trusted executive-level relationships with client leaders and internal partners.
· Act as a strategic advisor to clients—providing insight, guidance and best-fit solutions to achieve desired business outcomes.
· Champion the voice of the customer, ensuring feedback informs roadmap, delivery and solution decisions.
· Own client business objectives and success metrics.
· Lead development of integrated program plans, including scope, milestones, dependencies, resources and delivery schedules.

What you will need to have:
· Bachelor’s degree in business, operations or a related field or equivalent experience.
· 6+ years of experience in program and project management within business environments.
· Proven success delivering large, complex and strategic programs.
· Demonstrated experience with data-driven management, metrics and executive reporting.
· Experience influencing cross-functional teams.

What would be great to have:
· 3+ years of experience in the financial services or payments industry.
· Deep understanding of program/project management lifecycles and delivery governance.
· Broad knowledge of platform-based solutions and enterprise technology environments.

#LI-PN1
